_comment: English body for prompt-case-redact-pii. Sections keyed by Chinese heading; sources aligned by index.

sections.任务与输入:
Output redacted text and a field log; do not guess unlisted fields.
Inputs: Source text, sensitive-field list, and redaction format.
sections.提示词本体:
```text
Redact the source according to {fields}. Output redacted_text and redactions[] with field, location and replacement. Handle only listed fields; put suspected but unlisted fields in review[] without redacting them. replacement uses {format} and must not retain reversible original values.
```

Replace {field} placeholders with the current inputs before running.
sections.检查点:
- Listed fields are replaced irreversibly.
- Review items are not handled without authorisation.
- Locations link back to the source.
sections.失败分支:
- Missed redaction: extend the field list and rerun.
- Over-redaction: move unlisted items back to review.
sections.出处与边界: This site has not tested the effect of this prompt. See the sources for the mechanism; changing model, version or input can change the result.
